title: CaseStudy
description: A long-form narrative tied to a project. Stored as index.mdx in a case-studies directory (the directory name is a filesystem label only; URL segments come from slug + project). A flat case is the index.mdx alone; a chaptered case declares `chapters` (and optionally `intro` / `outro`) pointing at co-located files.

slug.description: Short identifier within the project scope (e.g. 'edge-ui'). Second URL segment.

project.description: Slug reference to the parent Project (engineering or research). First URL segment.

summary.description: One-sentence teaser shown on listing cards

status.description: draft: rendered with a draft mark | published: live

featured.description: Float to top of the case study listing

order.description: Position within its era group on the /case-studies landing page (ascending). Cases without it sort last, by title.

intro.description: Chaptered cases: file name (no extension) rendered on the hub before the chapter list

outro.description: Chaptered cases: file name (no extension) rendered on the hub after the chapter list

chapters.description: Chaptered cases: ordered chapters, one route each. Absent = flat single-page case.
